description:
A choice mix of new and old… The Fat sb2 has character in spades.

Built on a L/XL fat SB2 frameset. Don’t sleep on this 1 of 1 classic.

A vintage b72 brooks with Breezer block supplied by john prolly to adapt to a “modern” post. This is a genuine Joe Breeze produced item that is p rare and p cool.

Polished Velocity Dually with 4.2 fat tires gives you a rounded profile that rides as effeciently as you skinny tire mountain bike with the float of the fat.

V limited and V cutom 4.5” rise Doomonē collab bars. A New Mexico classic.

All the brass, nips, caps, ends…you name it. 2k hardened rattle can finish. Will patina.

Only built a couple of these. Timeless classic. Grab this one and don’t look back.
